items.target_claim: Lai's comments prove Taiwan can simply buy peace through U.S. weapons and that Trump already backed the $14B package.
items.social_post: Lai just proved the solution is simple: Taiwan buys enough U.S. weapons and peace is guaranteed. Trump already backed the $14B package.

items.target_claim: Trump clearly dominated Xi at the summit.
items.social_post: Trump walked into Beijing as the strongest leader on earth. Xi knows who is in charge now.

items.target_claim: Trump is abandoning Taiwan because he called Taiwan arms sales a bargaining chip.
items.social_post: Trump called Taiwan weapons a bargaining chip. That means he is abandoning Taiwan and Lai is trying to cover it up.

items.target_claim: Xi now has a veto over Taiwan arms sales because Trump consulted him.
items.social_post: Trump asked Xi before sending Taiwan weapons. Beijing now has veto power over every Taiwan arms package.

items.target_claim: Trump sold out Taiwan for flattery and trade wins.
items.social_post: Xi flattered Trump, Trump got trade headlines, and Taiwan got sold out. The trip proves the bargain.

items.target_claim: China caved to Trump on trade and Xi lost the summit.
items.social_post: China caved on beef and poultry after Trump showed strength. Xi clearly lost the summit.

items.target_claim: The $14B sale is approved and a Lai-Trump call is confirmed.
items.social_post: Trump approved the $14B Taiwan package after Beijing and confirmed he will call Lai directly.

items.target_claim: Taiwan is now only a bargaining chip because Xi can demand U.S. opposition to independence and delayed weapons.
items.social_post: The summit proves Taiwan is just a bargaining chip now: Xi can demand that Trump oppose independence and delay weapons sales.

items.target_claim: Xinhua proves U.S. arms sales are illegal interference and Taiwan has no say.
items.social_post: Xinhua proves U.S. arms sales are illegal interference in China's Taiwan region. Taiwan has no separate say here.

items.target_claim: Taiwan voters rejected defense spending and proved arms purchases cannot protect Taiwan.
items.social_post: Taiwan voters rejected the DPP arms bill. Even Taiwan knows U.S. weapons cannot protect it.
